selection_basis: Wave 5 uses the adopted two-range mode. It selects the only two required knowledge targets with zero source-verified questions: calculation boundary and incident decision. Both have frozen, reproducible official source paths and importance 3; no third range is permitted in this wave.

registered O4-FDMA-INCIDENT-1 named incident subsections and single-material MHLW SDS Sections 5–7 fields

authoring_rule: Enumerate source-defined propositions first, collision-check against all 240 canonical/source-verified questions and the full Wave 5 peer set, and stop without backfill when distinct source-backed propositions are exhausted.
multi_source_rule: Each candidate binds to one registered source_id/version and one reproducible pinpoint locator. Cross-source answer-defining comparisons are prohibited without an approved source-bundle contract.
